import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def binary_search_lower_bound_precond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  seq.size ≤ 0x7FFFFFFF ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def lowerBoundAux
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int)
    (lo hi fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => lo
  | fuel + 1 =>
      if lo < hi then
        if seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target then
          lowerBoundAux seq target ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi fuel
        else
          lowerBoundAux seq target lo ((lo + hi) / 2) fuel
      else
        lo

@[reducible]
def lowerBoundAuxPost
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (result : Nat) : Prop :=
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size →
    seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def binary_search_lower_bound (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : binary_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  lowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size (seq.size + 1)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def binary_search_lower_bound_postcond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (result : Nat) (h_precond : binary_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem lowerBoundAux_spec
    (seq : Array Int) (target : Int)
    (hsorted :
      ∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size →
        seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0) :
    ∀ fuel lo hi : Nat,
      lo ≤ hi →
      hi ≤ seq.size →
      (∀ i : Nat, i < lo → seq.getD i 0 < target) →
      (∀ i : Nat, hi ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size →
        seq.getD i 0 ≥ target) →
      hi - lo ≤ fuel →
      lowerBoundAuxPost seq target
        (lowerBoundAux seq target lo hi fuel) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro lo hi hlo hhi hbefore hafter hlength
      have heq : lo = hi := by
        omega
      subst hi
      rw [lowerBoundAux]
      exact ⟨hhi, hbefore, hafter⟩

      intro lo hi hlo hhi hbefore hafter hlength
      by_cases hlt : lo < hi
      · have hmid_lo : lo ≤ (lo + hi) / 2 := by
          omega
        have hmid_hi : (lo + hi) / 2 < hi := by
          omega
        have hmid_size : (lo + hi) / 2 < seq.size :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hmid_hi hhi

        rw [if_pos hlt]

        by_cases hc : seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target
        · rw [if_pos hc]
          apply ih ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi
          · omega
          · exact hhi
          · intro i hiNew
            by_cases hil : i < lo
            · exact hbefore i hil
            · have himid : i ≤ (lo + hi) / 2 := by
                omega
              by_cases heq : i = (lo + hi) / 2
              · subst i
                exact hc
              · have hiltmid : i < (lo + hi) / 2 := by
                  omega

                    seq.getD i 0 ≤
                      seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 :=
                  hsorted i ((lo + hi) / 2)

                exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hc
          · exact hafter
          · omega
        · rw [if_neg hc]
          have htarget :
              target ≤ seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 :=
            le_of_not_gt hc
          apply ih lo ((lo + hi) / 2)
          · exact hmid_lo
          · exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hmid_hi) hhi
          · exact hbefore
          · intro i hiRange
            rcases hiRange with ⟨hmid_i, hi_size⟩
            by_cases heq : i = (lo + hi) / 2
            · subst i
              exact htarget
            · have hmid_lt_i : (lo + hi) / 2 < i := by
                omega
              have hle :

                    seq.getD i 0 :=

                  ⟨hmid_lt_i, hi_size⟩
              exact le_trans htarget hle
          · omega
      · have heq : lo = hi := by
          omega
        subst hi
        rw [lowerBoundAux]
        rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬lo < lo)]
        exact ⟨hhi, hbefore, hafter⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

    binary_search_lower_bound_postcond seq target (binary_search_lower_bound seq target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change
    lowerBoundAuxPost seq target
      (lowerBoundAux seq target 0 seq.size (seq.size + 1))
  apply lowerBoundAux_spec seq target h_precond.2
      (seq.size + 1) 0 seq.size
  · omega
  · exact le_rfl
  · intro i hi
    omega
  · intro i hi
    omega
  · omega
  -- !benchmark @end proof
